Q: Hosting Microsoft Edge via WebView2Loader.dll with Excel VBA A:

Here's API to communicate with Chromium / EDGE from VBA without need to install any external libraries. https://www.codeproject.com/Tips/5307593/Automate-Chrome-Edge-using-VBA

It utilizes CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol): https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/

Q: How does Python handle floating point numbers when the round function is also involved? A:

I found function math.frexp() which shows float as mantissa and exponent

>>> math.frexp(12.675)
(0.7921875, 4)
>>> math.frexp(2.675)
(0.66875, 2)

Q: Version Control with XML diff and merge A:

I ran into the same problem with game config files — line-based diff tools don't understand spreadsheet structure, so you get meaningless conflicts.

I built a tool that does semantic diff and three-way merge for Excel/XML files, designed for the game dev workflow with SVN: https://github.com/noahsarkcc/smartdiff

Q: MySQL connection not working: 2002 No such file or directory A:

I had this error message connecting to a PhpBB forum online. Reloading the page did not help. Reloading from the bookmark gave the same error, but a message saying "return to the index page" appeared in the top right corner. Clicking on it brought back the forum.

Q: How to add a <br> tag after every 20 characters in a string A:

See wordwrap. Something like:

echo wordwrap($yourString, 20, '<br>');

But it might be a better idea to do this with CSS (word-wrap: break-word)

Q: Should I use Java Swing in 2026? A:

If you want a web based gui but only want to code in Java, https://vaadin.com/ could work for you. It's based on on gwt from Google that is very advanced.
